title: Restore the stock shock damping baseline

applicability.included: Exact standard US 2021 Yamaha YZ450F with original stock suspension.
excluded: Changed springs, revalving or replacement suspension

entry_state: Assembled bike with identified, serviceable stock suspension.
exit_state: Stock baseline or measured rider sag recorded; no internal overhaul performed.
preflight: Identify the exact bike and stock components. Save starting settings.
critical_stop_conditions: Unidentified adjuster or inability to reach a setting without force

source.review_note: Root author/source review and independent year_groups_research review accepted bounded setup. 2020 copyright locator corrected to4; no mechanical changes after review.

steps.title: Inspect the rear suspension
steps.instruction: Support the bike upright. Check the shock for leaks and damage. Load and unload the rear suspension several times; the shock and linkage must move smoothly. Correct faults before adjusting.
verification: Record the actual setting or measurement and confirm this step is complete.

steps.title: Save the starting settings
steps.instruction: Raise the rear wheel on a stable maintenance stand. Identify the bottom rebound control and the separate high-speed and low-speed compression controls from the linked diagrams. Gently count each setting toward hard and record it; never force the stops.
verification: Record the actual setting or measurement and confirm this step is complete.

steps.title: Set rebound
steps.instruction: From gently seated full hard, open the rebound adjuster 11 clicks toward soft. Record the actual setting.
verification: Record the actual setting or measurement and confirm this step is complete.

steps.title: Set high-speed compression
steps.instruction: From gently seated full hard, open the high-speed compression control 1 turns toward soft. This control is measured in turns, not clicks.
verification: Record the actual setting or measurement and confirm this step is complete.

steps.title: Set low-speed compression
steps.instruction: From gently seated full hard, open the low-speed compression control 9 clicks toward soft. Keep it distinct from the high-speed control.
verification: Record the actual setting or measurement and confirm this step is complete.

steps.title: Check and record
steps.instruction: Lower the bike securely. Confirm smooth shock and linkage movement without leaks. Save all three settings before a controlled evaluation ride. These factory settings are a baseline, not a personalized tune.
verification: Record the actual setting or measurement and confirm this step is complete.
